name: Ashen Crawler
description: A creature born from the residue of fractured memory. It does not know what it hunts.

name: Hollow Soldier
description: A warrior who survived the Fracture but lost the reason they fought. The body remembers. The self does not.

name: Memory Echo
description: A distortion given shape. It carries fragments of someone else's grief and mistakes them for weapons.

name: Fractured Sentinel
description: An echo of a guardian that no longer remembers what it guards. It cannot stand down because it cannot remember the order.

name: Shard Wraith
description: Too many shards. The creature that remains is defined entirely by what was forced into it.

name: Ancient Guardian
description: Something very old that has stood in one place for a very long time. It has forgotten the purpose. Not the post.

name: The Soldier Who Remembered
description: He looks at you with grief, not hatred. He has been waiting. He has had time to prepare exactly what he wants to say.
